description: UNDERSTANDING — Valuable artifact types (MCP, Arazzo, Rules, Skills…) commonly missing across a whole industry — where the vertical is under-served. Priced B2 (cross-catalog synthesis) — $0.05 per call under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. See apis://prices.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

min_share.description: Coverage threshold below which a type counts as an industry gap (0–1, default 0.5).
